How We Work

Treatment Process

01
Degreasing

Alkaline cleaning removes oils, grease and organic contaminants. Critical for adhesion.

02
Water Rinse

Thorough rinse eliminates cleaning agents. Prevents cross-contamination.

03
Acid Pickling

Controlled rust, scale and oxide removal. Clean, reactive metal surface.

04
Phosphating

Grey or black coating to exact specification. Tightly bonded conversion layer.

05
Final Finish

Post-treatment oiling or sealing. Inspected, finished, packaged for transit.
